aboutPage.title: A travel connector for Morocco, France & Belgium
aboutPage.metaDescription: LOC is a travel connector in Morocco, France, and Belgium — curated experiences, handpicked stays, and digital travel guides.
aboutPage.subtitle: Curated experiences, handpicked stays, and digital travel guides.
aboutPage.howItWorksBody: We connect curious travellers with authentic local providers, directly. Browse experiences, stays, and local products curated by people who actually live in the places they cover — when something looks right, you reach out and the provider takes it from there.
aboutPage.discoveryBody: LOC never processes bookings or payments itself. Every inquiry goes straight to the experience, stay, or product's own provider, who handles the rest directly with you.
aboutPage.partOfBody: LOC is one of the ventures built by <link>Impactors Academy</link>, a platform building ventures across tourism, sport, finance, and technology.
